messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] problems R.Huge.0.1.5, R.Huge.0.1.6 needed??
parts:
Hi,
Did you follow the installation instructions on the group page?

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")

If you try to manually install the necessary packages, there are often
complications.
Best,
Elizabeth
